correctness.rationale: With normalized errors \(u_n=(x_n-x_*)/(x_0-x_*)\) and residuals \(r_n=(q-1)(x_n-x_*)\), the bounded sum-to-one coefficient constraint reduces to the exact interval \([-a,1+a]\) for the older coefficient, where \(a=(\Lambda-1)/2\). While consecutive normalized errors are positive and decreasing, the projected minimizer either uses the endpoint and gives \(v_{n+1}=q((1+a)v_n-av_{n-1})\), or cancels the residual exactly. Induction identifies the first zero with the first nonpositive hypothetical recurrence value. The discriminant vanishes at \(a_{\pm}=(1\pm\sqrt{1-q})/(1\mp\sqrt{1-q})\); at and below \(a_-\), the characteristic roots imply \(v_n>0\) for every finite index, while above it oscillations or a negative dominant coefficient force a nonpositive value. For \(\Lambda=3\), the solution is \(v_n=q^{n/2}\cos(n\arccos\sqrt q)\), giving the exact first-zero index. The analytic argument handles every real \(q\) and index; 2,580 exact-rational supplementary checks were executed from the embedded verifier. Finite enumeration is not used to establish infinite positivity.

originality.rationale: The claim concerns exact finite versus nonfinite termination of capped depth-one Anderson on scalar affine contractions, the parameter boundary \((3-s)/(1+s)\), universal coefficient cap three, and its exact first-zero index. The 2026 Lerman–Zhang full text proves asymptotic rate improvement for each cap greater than one, without this finite-phase classification. The nearest published published-finding corpus record treats uncapped Anderson acceleration and derives a scalar first accelerated zero, which may require coefficients violating a finite cap. Barré–Taylor–d'Aspremont study one-shot extrapolation of precomputed Picard iterates, rather than a sliding window of accelerated residuals. Actual published-finding corpus and available prior research records searches identified no equivalent claim. Older specialized safeguard literature remains a historical-priority risk.
residual_risks: Older scalar extrapolation, safeguarded secant, or Chebyshev semiiteration literature could contain an equivalent formula under alternative terminology not surfaced by these searches.
Toth-Kelley 2015 full body was not accessible in this check; only abstract-level comparison is made there.
The same mathematical model theorem has not been independently validated; floating-point versions of exact finite termination are not claimed.

value.rationale: Coefficient caps are a motivated stabilization of Anderson acceleration. The result gives a complete exact phase diagram for finite termination at each positive scalar contraction, the smallest universal cap three, and an exact square-root-scaled stopping index. It distinguishes two improved-rate regimes (genuine finite completion versus a nonzero tail) that general convergence results cannot distinguish. This serves as a natural baseline for safeguarding and exact extrapolation, not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine rephrasing.
